history.text: Coastal towns became early centres of Islam and Indian Ocean trade.
The Adal Sultanate contested the region with Ethiopia.
Britain and Italy divided the territory into two protectorates.
The two territories united and became independent on 1 July.
The central state collapsed; Somaliland declared separate independence.
A federal government was established in Mogadishu.
